Operating hours of shopping malls in Metro Manila would be an hour later from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. to ease traffic during the holiday season, the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority announced on Friday.

The adjusted operating hours will take effect from Nov. 17 to Dec. 25.
